_description: One straight vessel, a single half-sine inlet flow pulse (data/inlet_flow_sine.csv: 0.25 s, 5 cm^3/s peak), terminated by the classic three-element (RCR) Windkessel from hemo1d_couplings: matched proximal impedance R1 = rho*c0/A0 (r1 = -1), one compliance C draining through R2 to p_out = 0. The textbook demo -- pressure builds during the pulse and then decays with time constant tau = R2*C instead of collapsing to zero.
